name: Single-Arm Push-Up on a Medicine Ball
how_to:
To perform the Single-Arm Push-Up on a Medicine Ball correctly, follow these steps:

1. Place a firm medicine ball on the floor and kneel beside it. Use a non-slip, medium-to-large ball for support.
2. Position one hand directly on top of the ball, with fingers spread for grip and the wrist stacked under the shoulder.
3. Extend both legs back into a plank. Place your feet slightly wider than hip-width for balance.
4. Tuck your non-working arm behind your back, palm resting lightly on your lower back or opposite glute.
5. Lower your chest slowly, bending only the working arm. Keep your elbow tucked in and your body aligned from head to heel.
6. Push back up through the ball to return to the top position without letting your body rotate or twist.
